_readme: Every model on the site. /container-homes/, /build/ and the sitemap all read this file, so a new model shows up everywhere at once.
id is what saved builds use (?config=). Never change it once a model is live. slug is the page URL: /models/{slug}/.
basePrice and maxPrice are the published range. Only publish numbers the written quote will honor.
rendering: true puts a visible 'Rendering' tag on the photo. Use it for anything that isn't a finished build.
pageLive: false until /models/{slug}/ exists. Until then the card links to photos instead of a dead page.
The fields from subhead down are the model page template. The page is plain HTML (copy /models/the-rising-sun/ for a new model); keep it in step with this entry.
Square-bracket text is a placeholder for the owner to fill in.
